Descripción De Puesto

This role is essential to ensuring paid media campaigns are executed with precision and continuously improved through data-driven insights. By managing day-to-day campaign operations, supporting agency collaboration, and monitoring performance, the Advertising Specialist helps maintain campaign efficiency, identify opportunities for optimization, and contribute to overall demand generation success.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Planning

Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, sales, and product teams to develop paid media strategy and audience approach.

Research advertising trends and platform best practices to enhance strategic media planning.

Support creative development for paid media assets by developing creative briefs, reviewing assets, and ensuring creatives align with our brand guidelines.

Build and segment ideal customer profiles on paid media channels using platform targeting and audience lists.

Own the end-to-end tracking of new media launches from campaign development to execution.

Collaborate closely with Corporate, regional marketing and content teams to align on paid messaging roadmaps for new campaign launches.

Support ad copywriting development as needed.

Develop testing roadmaps and prioritize based on business goals and seasonality.

Campaign Execution & Management

Collaborate with website and media technology team to ensure accurate implementation of campaign tracking, tagging, and URL taxonomy for consistent attribution and measurement.

Ensure campaigns are trafficked accurately, including ad set-up, audience targeting, creative uploads, and tracking implementation.

Partner with media agency to ensure timely and organized campaign launches.

Lead weekly campaign status meetings with agency partners to review campaign updates, optimizations, and opportunities.

Monitor media spends pacing and invoicing/reconciliation against planned budgets.

Oversee campaign launches, documenting and communicating changes and updates to stakeholders.

Conduct pre and post launch QA to validate campaign set-up.

Drive operational excellence by enhancing processes, establishing clear timelines, and accountability with agency partners.

Manage multiple campaigns and priorities, ensuring work is organized, tracked, and timely.

Campaign Measurement

Monitor and analyze channel KPIs and performance trends, translating data into actionable insights and recommendations.

Maintain accurate documentation of key results to inform future campaign planning and execution.

Own development and maintenance of weekly and monthly paid media reporting.

Partner with media agency to leverage insights to optimize campaigns and scale performance.

Ensure measurement accuracy, validating data across reporting platforms.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

2–4 years of experience in paid media, digital marketing, or campaign execution, with hands-on responsibility for campaign launches and optimization.

Proven experience executing campaigns across search, social, and programmatic channels (e.g., Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, DV360 or similar platforms).

Strong working knowledge of campaign trafficking, tagging, and QA processes, including experience with tracking frameworks (e.g., UTM parameters, pixels, conversion tracking).

Experience collaborating with media agencies and cross-functional teams (demand generation, brand, web, analytics), with the ability to manage deliverables and timelines effectively.

Experience in campaign performance analysis and reporting, with the ability to interpret KPIs and translate data into actionable insights.

Strong understanding of funnel metrics and conversion performance (MQL → SQL → revenue), with an ability to identify optimization opportunities.

Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and execution.

Advanced English is required

Tipo De Empleado

Permanente

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America's most ambitious companies. You will also apply expert-level strategic thinking to promote sustainable project growth, ensuring long-term success in performance marketing initiatives.

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

At Thrive Digital, we may use AI-assisted tools to support parts of our hiring process. All applications and hiring decisions are made by a human member of our team. If you have questions, please contact Michelle Nowacki (Associate Director, Talent Acquisition) at careers@thrivedigital.com.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We are seeking a Shopify Specialist to manage, maintain, and optimize our client's Shopify store. • Proactively audit the store to catch and resolve issues before they impact marketing campaigns or sales.

• Coordinate with the marketing team to ensure the store is fully prepared for new product launches and promotional campaigns.

• Make theme customizations using Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript as needed.

• Integrate and maintain third-party apps (e.g., Klaviyo for email marketing, review apps, etc.).

• Document all changes, issues, and resolutions clearly for internal reference.

• Provide proactive recommendations to improve the store's user experience, conversion rate, and operational efficiency.

• Work directly with leadership and follow internal processes for store management and quality control.




Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Advanced English proficiency, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience managing Shopify stores.

• Deep understanding of Shopify's backend, including product management, collections, discounts, and inventory settings.

• Experience working with fashion, apparel, or lifestyle DTC brands.

• Strong knowledge of Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

• Experience with Shopify Online Store 2.0, metafields, and custom sections.

• Exceptional attention to detail and a proactive approach to identifying and solving problems.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment and take full ownership of store operations.

• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.




Preferred Skills:

• Previous experience working directly with fashion brands or in the apparel e-commerce space.

• Experience with Klaviyo, Google Analytics, and other e-commerce marketing tools.

• Familiarity with SEO best practices for Shopify stores.

• Experience with project management tools (e.g., Asana, Trello, or Notion).

Personality:

• Detail-oriented, organized, and self-motivated professional who takes pride in delivering flawless work.

• Proactive problem-solver who doesn't wait for issues to escalate before taking action.

• Reliable and accountable, with a strong sense of ownership over the store's performance.

• Collaborative and communicative, comfortable providing updates and recommendations to leadership.

• Calm under pressure and able to manage urgent store issues with efficiency and professionalism.

• Shopify (required)

Culture at Scribd, Inc.

For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

About The Team And Role

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Everand Core team, you’ll help shape the future of how people discover, organize, and enjoy books. Everand is growing, and we’re evolving our reading and listening experiences to make stories more accessible, personal, and engaging for our readers.

You'll play a vital role in connecting readers with the stories they love by owning the backend platform that powers Everand's web and mobile experiences. This includes everything from rapid experimentation to the services driving discoverability, personalization, and our core consumption journeys. You'll work closely with engineers across search, recommendations, web, and mobile, as well as design and product partners, to align technical decisions with user needs and platform capabilities. Along the way, you'll build systems that drive performance, personalization, and reliability, and help shape the technical direction of our backend team.

We value quality over speed, thoughtful planning over short-term hacks, and continuous improvement over “just good enough.” We’re looking for engineers who share these values and who are energized by writing clean, scalable code, trying new technologies, and collaborating with diverse teams.

We believe the best experiences come from teams who care deeply about the people they build for, and each other.

The Customer Relations Specialist is responsible for handling and processing UPS customers' complaints about package delivery problems (i.e., missing and damaged items) and service failures (i.e., missed deliveries). Customer Service Representative

Global Advance (global-advance.de) es una agencia alemana de marketing digital. Serás el primer punto de contacto de nuestros clientes: resolverás sus dudas, coordinarás las respuestas con el equipo y te asegurarás de que cada cliente se sienta bien atendido — con rapidez, claridad y empatía.

- Atender las consultas de nuestros clientes por correo electrónico, chat y teléfono.

- Acompañar el onboarding de los nuevos clientes: primeros pasos, documentación y preguntas frecuentes.

- Recoger el feedback de los clientes y trasladarlo internamente para mejorar nuestros procesos.

- Comunicación escrita clara, ortografía impecable y un tono cercano y profesional.

Valorable (no excluyente)

Consta de cuatro pasos: primero revisamos tu perfil, después mantenemos una breve videollamada, a continuación te proponemos un pequeño caso práctico de atención al cliente y, por último, tomamos la decisión final.
